description:
ARMAGEDDON, a five-issue event series by acclaimed writer Chip Zdarsky and rising star artists Delio Diaz and Frank Alpizar, transforms Earth's Mightiest Heroes in a way not seen since Avengers: Disassembled.

Red Hulk's devastating tear across the globe must be stopped...but it will take a colossal gathering of Earth's Mightiest Heroes to do it! Calling in the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, Wolverine and more. When the dust settles on the cataclysmic showdown, a new era of Avengers begins, assembling a bold lineup including an all new hero with unrivaled power...
